# Original arrow preset controls

`public/fixtures/arrow-homePlate.docx` and `arrow-chevron.docx` are generated by
`tools/arrow_preset_fixture.py` from our original shape-defaults package. They
contain no corpus artwork or third-party renderer output. Each document has
8 independent DrawingML controls: default, negative and excessive adjustments,
values either side of the chevron text-rectangle threshold, portrait dimensions,
and a shape with both flips and a 30-degree rotation. Five centered Arial labels
exercise the actual text rectangles, including the equality branch in a tall
chevron. The transformed shape is separated from neighboring shapes to avoid
coupling geometry samples to overlapping cached-raster edges.

`native.pdf` was exported directly from the unmodified fixture by the
reference application. `tools/arrow_preset_reference.py` records native green
and white samples with uniform neighborhoods, plus text origins from that PDF.
It never calculates expected geometry from the application implementation.
The JSON records SHA-256 hashes of the fixture and PDF. Re-export the PDF in the reference application
after regenerating a fixture, then rerun the reference recorder.

The unit tests check specification geometry and invalid adjustments. Browser
tests compare all recorded ink samples and all ten text origins, then exercise
body editing, shape-markup preservation, export/reopen and exact undo.
The references are verification evidence, not a full conformance certification.
